value.title: Iron Fist S2#5
value.text: BB's gang holds a wounded Danny Rand hostage for a bounty, and Danny urges him to choose a better path. BB calls Colleen to tell her where Danny is.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A gang kid who holds Danny hostage, then calls Colleen to save him.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#8
split.text: BB turns on Davos and helps Joy steal the bowl that can take back the Iron Fist.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Iron Fist BB helps against Davos.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A gang kid who turns on Davos and helps steal his bowl.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#9
split.text: BB brings Danny and Colleen the bowl, and is stabbed to death by fellow gang member Crank.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Iron Fist BB's gang holds hostage, whom BB later helps.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A gang kid who holds Danny hostage, then helps him against Davos.

verdicts.why: S2#5 start is right, but the proposed S2#8 split includes BB's death, which is in S2#9 (War Without End: BB hands over the bowl at Bayard and is stabbed by Crank). Split into S2#8 and S2#9.
S2#7: Davos goes to Ryhno's gang, offers food, lodging and training, and they accept him as Shifu; the training and BB's rebellion and the bowl theft are S2#8.
S2#1: after an NA meeting his sponsor Bethany tries to get Ward to open up and they have sex in a storage room; S2#4 only has her stepping down as sponsor.

value.title: Iron Fist S1#5
value.text: Claire Temple trains in martial arts under Colleen Wing at the Chikara Dojo, and the two are friends.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Claire's martial arts teacher and friend.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Colleen's student and friend at the Chikara Dojo.

split.title: Iron Fist S1#11
split.text: Claire learns that Colleen was part of the Hand and scolds her for hiding it, but stands by her as a close friend.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Claire's martial arts teacher and close friend.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Colleen's student and close friend, who stands by her through the fight against the Hand.

verdicts.why: Claire first appears training with Colleen in S1#5, but she only learns Colleen was in the Hand in S1#11 (Lead Horse Back to Stable), so that part is split out.

value.title: Iron Fist S1#5
value.text: Claire Temple meets Danny Rand through Colleen and becomes his friend, treating the wounded chemist he rescues from the Hand.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Claire meets through Colleen, at war with the Hand.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Colleen's student, a former nurse who becomes Danny's friend.

split.title: Iron Fist S1#11
split.text: Claire patches up the stab wound Bakuto gives Danny and keeps helping him through his war with the Hand.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A friend Claire patches up through his war with the Hand.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's friend, who patches him up through his war with the Hand.

verdicts.why: They meet in S1#5, but Claire first patches Danny up in S1#11, when she pulls Bakuto's blade out and staples his wound; in S1#5 she treats Bernivig. Split.

value.title: Iron Fist S2#8
value.text: Danny comes to believe the Iron Fist belongs with Colleen and suggests she take its power from Davos.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Colleen's boyfriend, who believes the Iron Fist belongs with her.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, who he believes should hold the Iron Fist.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#9
split.text: Colleen agrees to take the Iron Fist, and Danny guides her through the Crane Sisters' ritual to draw it out of Davos, but Davos wakes and interrupts it, leaving the power split between them.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Colleen's boyfriend, who guides her through the ritual to take the Iron Fist.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, whom he guides through the ritual to take the Iron Fist.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#10
split.text: Colleen draws the rest of the Iron Fist out of Davos and becomes the new Iron Fist.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Colleen's boyfriend, who helps her take the Iron Fist from Davos.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, whom he helps take the Iron Fist.

verdicts.why: Danny first says Colleen should hold the Iron Fist at the end of S2#8, but she agrees and the interrupted ritual come in S2#9 and she completes the transfer in S2#10, so those are split out. Danny never holds the power to pass it.

value.text: Danny comes to believe the Iron Fist belongs with Colleen and suggests she take its power from Davos.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Colleen's boyfriend, who believes the Iron Fist belongs with her.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, who he believes should hold the Iron Fist.

verdicts.why: Right that Danny cannot pass on a power Davos holds; he guides Colleen through the ritual in S2#9. Since this stage moves to S2#8 (item 685), the text is cut to the S2#8 facts and the ritual goes into 685's splits.

value.title: Iron Fist S2#4
value.text: Davos steals the Iron Fist from Danny, making him Colleen's enemy.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's old friend, who steals the Iron Fist. Now Colleen's enemy.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, set against Davos once he steals the Iron Fist.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#9
split.text: Colleen fights Davos and his gang alongside Danny and Misty.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's old friend, who steals the Iron Fist. Now Colleen's enemy.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, who fights Davos once he steals the Iron Fist.

verdicts.why: The theft is at the end of S2#4, but Colleen's fights with Davos, with Danny and Misty, start in S2#9 at Bayard and end in S2#10, so the fighting is split out.

value.title: Iron Fist S2#2
value.text: Danny brings Mary home to Colleen's apartment when she seems lost and dehydrated, and Colleen teases him that Mary has a crush on him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A seemingly lost woman Danny brings home.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, who teases him that Mary has a crush on him.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#3
split.text: Mary is secretly photographing Colleen and Danny for Joy and Davos.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A seemingly lost woman, secretly spying on Colleen and Danny for Joy and Davos.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, whom Mary secretly photographs for Joy and Davos.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#4
split.text: Colleen suspects Mary is watching them.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A seemingly lost woman, secretly spying on Colleen and Danny for Joy and Davos.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's girlfriend, who suspects Mary is watching her.

verdicts.why: Mary meets Colleen in S2#2 and the photos surface in S2#3, but Colleen only says Mary may be watching them in S2#4 (Target: Iron Fist), so that is split again. In S2#2 nothing hostile is shown yet, so that stage is friend.
Ward bribes Colleen (S1#2) and his men attack her (S1#3); they only work together in S1#13, when Ward joins Danny, Colleen and Claire against Harold.
In S1#13 Ward allies with Danny, Colleen and Claire to defeat Harold; the Hand has already left, so 'against Harold' is the fact.
S1#12: Davos kills Bakuto, Danny attacks him, and Davos voices his jealousy and anger over K'un-Lun and leaves. Telling Joy that Danny must be killed is S1#13.
End of S1#13: Davos tells Joy the only way to stop Danny ruining their lives is to kill him, and Joy says she is listening. S2#1 shows them already working together.

value.title: Iron Fist S1#1
value.text: Lei Kung is Danny's master in K'un-Lun, who trained him through harsh lessons.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The boy Lei Kung trained in K'un-Lun.

split.title: Iron Fist S1#4
split.text: Lei Kung trains Danny in K'un-Lun and prepares him to become the Iron Fist.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's teacher in K'un-Lun, who trains him to be the Iron Fist.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The boy Lei Kung trains to become the Iron Fist.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#2
split.text: Lei Kung raises Danny alongside his son Davos and names Danny the winner of their duel for the right to face Shou-Lao.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's teacher in K'un-Lun and adoptive father, who makes him the Iron Fist.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The boy Lei Kung trains and raises as his own, to become the Iron Fist.

verdicts.why: Lei Kung is named as Danny's master already in S1#1 (Danny tells Colleen Master Lei Kung hit him many times); in S1#4 Danny tells Joy he trained under Lei Kung to become the Iron Fist. The duel and raising alongside Davos stay at S2#2.

value.title: Iron Fist S1#6
value.text: Madame Gao tests Danny Rand, the Iron Fist, against her champions and overpowers him.

value.on_b_card_about_a: The Iron Fist, whom Gao tests against her champions.

split.title: Iron Fist S1#8
split.text: Danny fights Gao and the Hand in Anzhou and takes her prisoner.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A Hand leader who tests Danny, then becomes his prisoner.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The Iron Fist, whom Gao tests and who takes her prisoner.

verdicts.why: They first meet at Gao's Da Jue Zhan in S1#6, but Danny takes her prisoner in S1#8, so that is split out. Gao never kidnaps him.

value.text: Madame Gao tests Danny Rand, the Iron Fist, against her champions and overpowers him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Hand leader who tests Danny against her champions.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The Iron Fist, whom Gao tests against her champions.

verdicts.why: Right that Gao never kidnaps Danny; he accepts her Da Jue Zhan in S1#6 and captures her in S1#8. Since the stage moves to S1#6 (item 694), the prisoner fact goes into 694's S1#8 split.
S1#1: Ward rejects Danny's claim to the controlling 51%, reaches for a gun, Danny recalls Ward bullying him, and Ward sends Shannon's men to kill him.
End of S1#12: Ward warns Danny that Harold set him up, just as DEA agents arrive. The alliance against Harold and the rooftop shooting are S1#13.
S2#2: Joy and Davos blackmail Mika Prada for the bowl the ritual needs. Joy fearing Davos and hiring Walker for protection is S2#5.
S2#8: Joy tries to undermine Davos and BB helps her steal the bowl; Davos pushes her off a balcony in S2#9.

value.title: Iron Fist S2#3
value.text: Davos works with Mary Walker in his plan against Danny, as she spies on Danny for him and Joy.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A hired spy working for Davos and Joy against Danny.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Mary's partner in the plan against Danny.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#6
split.text: Walker turns on Davos, planning to kill him, and helps Danny subdue him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A former ally against Danny, who turns on Davos.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Mary's former partner in the plan against Danny, whom she turns on.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#10
split.text: Walker lies in wait for Davos and tries to kill him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A former ally against Danny, who turns on Davos and tries to kill him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Mary's former partner in the plan against Danny, whom she tries to kill.

verdicts.why: The link starts at the end of S2#3 (Davos and Joy confront Walker over photos they paid for), but there she works for him; she turns on him in S2#6 and tries to kill him in S2#10. Split, with the S2#3 stage as ally.

value.title: Iron Fist S2#9
value.text: Misty helps Danny and Colleen take Davos down, sneaking his unconscious body back to the dojo instead of arresting him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A detective who helps take Davos down.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's adoptive brother, whom Misty helps take down.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#10
split.text: Once Davos is finally caught, Misty lets Danny say a last goodbye before taking him to jail.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A detective who helps take Davos down and lets Danny say goodbye.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's adoptive brother, whom Misty helps take down and jail.

verdicts.why: S2#9 is right for Misty letting the sedated Davos go to the ritual, but his arrest and Danny's goodbye are in S2#10 (A Duel of Iron), so they are split out.

value.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's friend, set against Davos once he steals the Iron Fist.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The thief of the Iron Fist, which he takes from Ward's friend Danny.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#8
split.text: Afraid for Joy, Ward teams up with Mary Walker to go after Davos.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's friend, who teams with Walker to go after Davos.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The thief of the Iron Fist, whom Ward and Walker go after.

verdicts.why: The theft is at the end of S2#4, but Ward never fights Davos alongside Danny and Colleen; he strikes his deal with Walker to go after Davos in S2#8, which is split out.

value.text: Davos steals the Iron Fist from Danny, setting him against Danny's friend Ward.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's friend, set against Davos once he steals the Iron Fist.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The thief of the Iron Fist, which he takes from Ward's friend Danny.

verdicts.why: Right that Ward does not fight Davos with Danny and Colleen; he teams with Walker against Davos from S2#8. Since the stage moves to S2#4 (item 702), the Walker team-up goes into 702's S2#8 split.
Jeri first meets Harold in S1#13, when he walks in on her meeting with Ward and she is shocked he is alive.

value.title: Iron Fist S1#3
value.text: Madame Gao controls Harold Meachum and punishes him for leaving his hidden penthouse to visit Danny.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A mysterious woman who controls Harold and punishes him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A tycoon in hiding whom Gao controls.

split.title: Iron Fist S1#4
split.text: Harold reveals the Hand brought him back from death to exploit him and Rand Enterprises, and Gao rewards him for securing the pier.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Hand leader who controls Harold and his company.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Resurrected tycoon whom Gao controls.

split.title: Iron Fist S1#5
split.text: Gao uses Rand Enterprises and its pier for her heroin trade.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Hand leader who controls Harold and uses his company.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Resurrected tycoon Gao controls for her drug trade.

verdicts.why: S1#3 is right (Gao makes Harold kneel on glass), but in S1#3 she is not yet tied to the Hand, and her heroin running through Rand Enterprises' pier only comes out in S1#5. The S1#4 split is cut back and the drug trade goes to S1#5.

value.title: Iron Fist S1#3
value.text: Jeri Hogarth takes on Danny Rand's fight to reclaim his place at Rand Enterprises against Ward and Joy Meachum, admitting she has a complicated history with Ward.

split.title: Iron Fist S1#13
split.text: Ward comes to Jeri claiming he has changed, just as his supposedly dead father Harold walks in.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's rival at Rand, who comes to Jeri claiming he has changed.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's lawyer, whom Ward tells he has changed.

verdicts.why: Jeri takes Danny's case and mentions her complicated history with Ward in S1#3, but Ward's visit when Harold walks in is S1#13, so it is split out.

value.title: Iron Fist S2#3
value.text: Joy Meachum hires Mary Walker to spy on Danny Rand for her and Davos.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The spy Joy hires to watch Danny.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#4
split.text: Walker captures Danny for Joy and Davos.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The spy Joy hires to watch and capture Danny.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Mary's employer, who hires her to spy on Danny.

split.title: Iron Fist S2#5
split.text: Once Davos turns dangerous, Joy turns to Walker for protection, even as Walker's other personalities work against the plan.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The spy Joy hires to watch Danny, then for protection from Davos.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Mary's employer, who hires her to spy on Danny.

verdicts.why: Walker is on Joy's payroll by the end of S2#3, but the capture of Danny she was hired for only happens in S2#4, so the capture is split out to S2#4.
End of S2#5: Misty and Colleen get into Joy's apartment, overpower Walker and take them both to the dojo. Misty questioning Joy about the Crane Sisters' ritual is S2#6.
S2#1: Joy asks to be bought out of Rand Enterprises and is already working with Davos. She refuses to forgive Ward and leaves him in S2#6.
S2#8: at Joy's apartment Ward agrees to help Walker get her redacted file if she helps protect Joy from Davos. The Turk Barrett guns and the Eden Towers raid are S2#9.
S1#9: Claire suggests truth serum, but Danny steals it from Rand Enterprises and gives it to Gao.

value.title: Iron Fist S1#2
value.text: Harold Meachum, Danny's father's old partner, tries to buy Colleen off through his son Ward to testify against Danny.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's father's old partner, who tries to bribe Colleen through Ward.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A dojo owner Harold tries to bribe into testifying against Danny.

split.title: Iron Fist S1#13
split.text: Harold holds Colleen at gunpoint at Rand Enterprises, and she helps Danny bring him down.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Danny's foe. Tries to bribe Colleen and holds her at gunpoint.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Danny's ally, who helps bring Harold down.

verdicts.why: The bribe is S1#2 (Harold sends Ward to offer Colleen money to testify), but holding her at gunpoint and his fall are S1#13, so they are split out.
S1#13: Claire gets Danny and Colleen to Jeri, who shows them the DEA files, and Danny sees they are doctored Hand records.

value.text: Happy Hogan tails Eric Savin to the TCL Chinese Theatre, where Savin delivers a package to another Extremis soldier and fights Happy. The soldier explodes, leaving Happy badly hurt and in a coma.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Stark's security chief. Tails Savin and is put in a coma by the blast.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Extremis agent Happy tails to the theater, where a blast puts Happy in a coma.

verdicts.why: Right that the blast is Taggart's, not Savin's, but Savin delivers Extremis suppressants to Taggart, not Extremis itself, so the hand-off is reworded.
By Miami, Savin has the Iron Patriot armor; Rhodes smashes through the window with a gun and threatens to break Trevor's face out of armor.

value.title: Ironheart#2
value.text: Riri Williams blackmails arms collector Joe McGillicuddy into supplying parts for her suit, and he starts working on it with her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A young inventor who blackmails Ezekiel into supplying parts.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An arms collector Riri blackmails into supplying parts.

split.title: Ironheart#3
split.text: Joe is really Ezekiel Stane, Obadiah Stane's son, and he becomes Riri's friend and collaborator, warning her against his father's mistakes and giving her biomesh skin.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Friend and collaborator Ezekiel supplies with parts.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Obadiah Stane's son, a friend and collaborator who supplies Riri with parts.

split.title: Ironheart#4
split.text: After the biomesh Riri loses is traced to Ezekiel and he is arrested, he grows bitter and turns against her.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Former friend whose lost biomesh exposes Ezekiel.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Former friend who turns on Riri after she exposes him.

split.title: Ironheart#5
split.text: Ezekiel attacks Riri with his new bionics and wrecks her suit, and the Hood then takes control of his body.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Former friend Ezekiel attacks.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Former friend who attacks Riri, then is controlled by the Hood.

split.title: Ironheart#6
split.text: The Hood turns the controlled Ezekiel against Riri, who frees him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Former friend who frees Ezekiel from the Hood.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Former friend who turns on Riri, then is controlled by the Hood.

verdicts.why: Ep 2 is the start, but there Riri only blackmails 'Joe' for parts; he is revealed as Zeke Stane in ep 3, and the Hood's control of him comes in ep 5 and ep 6, which the proposed ep 4 split wrongly includes. Split by episode.

value.title: Ironheart#5
value.text: Ezekiel Stane is drawn into the fight around the Hood, and Parker Robbins hacks Stane's bionic implants and takes control of him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Villain who hacks Ezekiel's bionics and takes control of him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Man whose bionic implants the Hood hacks and controls.

split.title: Ironheart#6
split.text: Riri Williams frees Ezekiel from Parker's control.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Villain who controls Ezekiel until Riri frees him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Man whose bionics the Hood controls until Riri frees him.

verdicts.why: Parker takes control of Zeke's body in ep 5, but Riri only frees him in ep 6, so that is split out. Parker's gang breaking Zeke out in ep 4 may need its own ally stage.
Ep 1 shows Gary, Riri and Natalie in the garage in flashback and says Natalie and Gary died in the same drive-by shooting, with Gary shielding Natalie.
Zelma first appears in ep 4 (only mentioned in ep 1), where Madeline explains she left Kamar-Taj to raise her and the two show their magic.
